contexts.text: If thou hast lied to me () = without doubt.
They know how to counterfeit... good and truth.
Had learned to counterfeit Angels of light. AC 7424:end.
They had counterfeited zeal...
What is fictitious, simulated, counterfeit, and deceitful, reigns within...
A lie from the life of cupidities. Signified, Explained.

There are some in the world who act by artifices and lies, whence come evils. (Their method of acting described.) Such relate to... the spurious tubercles which grow in the pleura and other membranes... (The punishment of such Spirits, described.) They have a most intense sight, instantly seeing and snatching at anything as means to favour them... They may also be called death-bringing ulcers... whether in the pleura, the pericardium, the mediastinum, or the lungs... After punishment, such are rejected to the back, into the deep, where they lie face downwards, with little of human life; thus deprived of their clearsightedness, which had been a ferine life. Their Hell is in a deep place, beneath the right foot, a little in front. SE 1761.
The prophet the teacher of a lie is the tail (); where the tail = falsity, which in the Word is called a lie.
Full of a lie () = falsity.

Let them not look back to words of a lie () = lest they turn themselves to truths... The words of a lie, when said by those who are in falsities, = truths. For those who are in falsities call truths falsities...
To speak lies = falsities, as is openly said.

Thou shalt not answer to thy neighbour the witness of a lie () = that good is not to be called evil, nor truth falsity; and that, on the other hand, evil is not to be called good, nor falsity truth. The witness of a lie = the confirmation of falsity... A lie = what is false of faith. Explained.
A lie is often mentioned in the Word, and by it is everywhere signified what is false and evil of faith... Illustrated.
A lie () = falsity.
Vanity = falsity of doctrine; and a lie, falsity of life. Illustrated. AC 10287:6.
From the word of a lie thou shalt keep thyself far () = aversion for falsity from evil. A lie = falsity from evil... because this falsity is to be kept far away...
A lie () = the falsity of evil.
No one is (there) allowed to counterfeit affections...
To multiply a lie and vastation () = to falsify truths, and thus destroy the Church.
To bear false witness means... also to lie...
As a lie and the Truth are two opposite things, it follows that in proportion as anyone shuns a lie as a sin, he loves the Truth.
The liars who shall be foolish () = the falsities of their doctrine.
And hast found them liars () = that they are in falsities. AR 79:2. Explained.
But do lie () = when yet there is no Church with them.
By a lie, in the Word, are signified falsity, and false-speaking.
Liars () = ... those who are in falsities from evil. AR 892:end.

That doeth abomination and a lie () = who does evils from confirmation, and thus also falsities... A lie = falsities of every kind; here, the falsities of evil, which in themselves are evils; thus falsities which confirm evil, which are the same as confirmed evils.

The reason a lie = falsity of doctrine, is that a spiritual lie is nothing else; hence by to make a lie is signified to live according to the falsities of doctrine. That a lie, in the Word, = falsity of doctrine. Illustrated.
Whosoever loveth and maketh a lie () = who makes the precepts of the decalogue of no account...
By (the eighth commandment), in a wider natural sense, are meant lies of every kind and political hypocrisies, which have an evil end in view.
This falsity of faith is meant in the Word by a lie. Illustrated.
As by a lie is meant falsity, the Lord says that the devil speaks a lie from what is his Own ().
A lie = falsity and false-speaking, in these places also. Illustrated.
Persuasion counterfeiting faith.
Can counterfeit Angels of light.
The opposites to Truths... are called lies, and Falsities...
That Spirits... lie. General article. SE 2747.
It is what counterfeits the Celestial.
They do not lie with the end of deceiving...
He counterfeited what is just and true more perfectly than any other man.
Used in the sense of counterfeit. AE 1013:2.
To make a lie = to think and will falsity from evil.
To lie = to be in falsities; for a lie, in the Word, = falsity of doctrine.
A lie = falsity from evil. AE 589:2.
To speak a lie = to believe falsities.
Their falsity from evil is signified by when he speaketh a lie, he speaketh from his Own. His Own = the evil of the will; and a lie = the derivative falsity.
A lie = the Divine truth, or the Word, adulterated.
II. Lies and revilings also are false witness.
To speak a lie = to teach falsity from ignorance of truth.
Deceit, and a lie = to persuade falsities from set purpose and cupidity.
They became (celestial) Angels by accounting as heinous... lies and slanderings, which to them were false witness. AE 1019:2.
